body:
N-39 BUILD, 17 Nov 2026 (helper-n39s). Built, not walked; fakes only, nothing run on a device, VM 108 or the A35. Docs: 33 PB-44 (the Stop, with its walk) and PB-45 (the question before Remove) are new; PB-40, PB-43, PB-F22 and audit B-134 follow what is built; S-16 row and CHANGELOG say it.

WHAT. Stop under a download line and in the sheet; Stopping...; Stopped with the files kept and Resume; one card Prog snob is stopped; Remove always asks (sheet, Settings trash, Remove all); the old cancel reads Interrupted before it finished. The stop is pins.stopped_at_ms (schema 9, the migration only adds the column; migration_test runs v1-v8 and keeps a pin).

THE PINS, each with a test that FAILS when it is broken (mutations run one at a time in a throwaway copy, each caught by a named test):
1 stored and surviving a restart: stop not written (16 red), held in memory only (4), column not migrated (8), start() leaves a task running for a stopped song (1).
2 the back-off trap: cancel before the stop is stored (2), both layers of the cancel gone (3), only the second layer gone (1, its own test).
3 deletes nothing: Stop deletes a copy (3), the late-failure guard gone (1), a refresh in flight left queued (2).
4 Resume and later songs: planner queues a held new song (1), pump starts stopped rows (9), Resume plans nothing (7), Retry requeues stopped (1), failed song of a stopped download retried (1), refresh planned for a stopped song (1), queue ordered by id (1), a song that joins a stopped release is not stopped (2), the next start's resume and the saver pin without the release (2), keep/ask sent for a stopped download (2), Resume does not ask again (1), a release stopped when ANY song is (1).
5 Remove: sheet Remove does not ask (5), Settings trash (3), Cancel removes (3), Stop removes (1), Remove all does not wait for the answer (1), Cancel in Remove all removes (1).
6 reasons: old failure wording for the outside cancel (2), Stop records the failure text (3), Retry on a stopped line (2).
7 the card: stopped stays a running job (2), import words (3), dated card includes it (1), import merged into the stopped line (1), import merged away when it stops finding so its end card is lost (4). No button on any card: notifications test.
NOT caught, said plainly: ORDER BY rowid of the queued rows (SQLite already returns rowid order for that query; an order by track id IS caught). It stays as the explicit contract.

HOLES FOUND AND CLOSED beyond the brief: (a) a catalogue release is one pin per song, so a song pinned later (the saver, or the next start's resume after a kill) would have started by itself: pin(alongside:) makes it stopped in the same write; a song asked for on its own still starts. (b) the drawing says a stopped download sends no keep/ask and Resume asks again: the keep controller now does that (watch goes on).

DEVIATIONS / QUESTIONS FOR THE LEAD. 1 Pin 1 said the download row; the stop is on the pin row (only a pin can say songs added later wait; the downloads table stays free for N-45). 2 Pin 6 first half: the drawing says a person's stopped songs are not failures (no name, no reason); I followed the drawing, tests hold both sentences. 3 No frame for 0 or 1 song on the phone: the drawn sentence with the plural inside it. 4 D3: while a Download is stopped the import of its playlist is a job of its own (own key, any state), so its end card is posted: a transition test (finding, then over) caught a first version that lost it. 5 Not the server (no route cancels one download's keeping: cost in PB-44).

NOT DONE / FOR OTHERS: the walk (row in PB-44 and the PR body); Arabic N-41; N-42 frames; N-45 (task id per attempt: a second migration, comes after); N-40. A side effect N-42 case 1 wants: while a Download is stopped, an import stopped elsewhere posts Import stopped; with the Download going the gap of PB-43 (i) stays.
